question: When are varied knowledges of difference extended in Śiva?
premises: varied knowledges of difference are extended here
even in what is called Śiva
when three faces unite left and right
inference: Varied knowledges of difference were extended here even in what is called Śiva, when the union of left and right of the three faces occurs.
plain_english: Varied knowledges of difference were extended here even in what is called Śiva, when the union of left and right of the three faces occurs.
